title: Total solar eclipse 2026: Why this tiny Spanish village will go dark twice this August
summary_full: Avellanosa de Muño will host Spain's first total solar eclipse since 1912.  Daylight will briefly disappear as the Moon covers the Sun near sunset.  This event offers a unique viewing experience unlike a midday eclipse.  Later that night, the Perseid meteor shower will also be visible.  The village's rural setting provides ideal conditions for astronomical observation.
